description:
Outcome: Persist household, 40-plot, season and prior-season data enabling allocation, from brief.md Background and Rules
Scope: TypeScript Next.js/npm scaffold, PostgreSQL migrations, entities and transactions; unique household+season and plot+season allocations; canonical household membership, coordinator-maintained history and season/timezone configuration; seed/import validation; establish test/build/dev scripts and test sources. Excludes: authentication implementation, allocation algorithm/UI and map
Acceptance: Exactly 40 distinct plots; validated households/history/dates survive restart; allocation constraints reject duplicates and races; timezone and March–October season configuration explicit; document coordinator bootstrap for T-003; establish commands before enabling Full pipeline stages
Behaviour: Rollback failed migrations/invalid writes with actionable errors; no silent missing-history assumption
Verification: Migration/constraint tests and representative prior-season fixtures; demonstrate actual npm test/build/dev commands before enabling stages. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: approved TypeScript/Next.js/PostgreSQL; exact dates/timezone configured by coordinator
title: Persistent garden foundation and verification tooling
